newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Nigerian woman for smuggling drugs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Nigerian woman for smuggling drugs.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday executed a woman for the first time this year, beheading Nigerian Zahra Isa Ali for smuggling drugs into the kingdom.
The public beheading raised to 58 the number of executions this year in the conservative Islamic kingdom. Ali was the 17th person to be put to death on drugs charges in the past two months.
An Interior Ministry statement, carried by the official Saudi Press Agency, said the woman was beheaded in Jeddah after being convicted of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin.
The kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
